headline: Sensex and Nifty snap seven-day rally in Diwali Muhurat trading session

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian benchmark indices dipped marginally during the special Diwali Muhurat trading session.
The small drop snapped a seven-day winning rally for the Indian stock market.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys were among the top losers dragging down benchmark indices.
Pharma and metal stocks logged gains even as indices ended marginally in the red.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the special annual Muhurat trading session on Diwali.
Sensex and Nifty closed slightly lower, ending in the red on Diwali after eight years.
Nifty closed below the 25,000 mark during the short trading session.
Kalpataru expressed confidence in meeting its Rs 6,500-crore pre-sales target for FY27 on strong housing demand.
summary:
Indian equities ended slightly lower during the special Diwali Muhurat trading session, ending a 7-day winning streak.
Nifty closed below 25,000 with major heavyweights Bharti Airtel and Infosys ending among the key losers.
Pharma and metal sectors recorded gains despite the broad market pausing after its recent rally.
